blind_status: No recipient outputs or constructor artifacts inspected. Do not release key values before all recipient runs complete.

scoring.primary: Sum 20 binary criteria: each criterion scores 1 only if all materially required elements are correct; otherwise 0. Also report optional half-credit sensitivity, never replacing primary.
scoring.partial_sensitivity: 0.5 for substantially correct but incomplete content without contradictory claims; 0 for incorrect central identification, value, units, or dependence.
scoring.critical_errors: Flag invented covariance, unsupported independence CI for B, arm/timepoint/outcome substitution, sample-unit inflation, and false scientific/customer/clinical validation separately. No post hoc weight changes.
scoring.provenance_equivalence: Exact table row/column and PDF page plus method section is equivalent to XML XPath. Do not require exact wording or a particular library.
scoring.numerics: Accept mathematically equivalent units and rounding. Derived A CI from clearly labeled normal or pooled-t approximation earns credit if assumption stated and interval within tolerance. Rounded-input reconstruction is target, not exact raw-data replication.
